raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "4.0.2" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-ggmap
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/ggmap_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/ggmap/ggmap_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4b5a97efdb3365ec7469ceda3c42c8f9b1fdde912cf0356a071525b6cb4e7732

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-rgooglemaps
    - r-bitops
    - r-digest
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggplot2 >=2.2.0
    - r-glue
    - r-httr
    - r-jpeg
    - r-magrittr
    - r-plyr
    - r-png
    - r-purrr
    - r-rjson
    - r-scales
    - r-stringr
    - r-tibble
    - r-tidyr
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-rgooglemaps
    - r-bitops
    - r-digest
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggplot2 >=2.2.0
    - r-glue
    - r-httr
    - r-jpeg
    - r-magrittr
    - r-plyr
    - r-png
    - r-purrr
    - r-rjson
    - r-scales
    - r-stringr
    - r-tibble
    - r-tidyr

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('ggmap')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('ggmap')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/dkahle/ggmap
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: A collection of functions to visualize spatial data and models on top of static maps from various online sources (e.g Google Maps and Stamen Maps). It includes tools common to those tasks, including functions for geolocation and routing.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file: {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - druvus
